# callisto configuration — see https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto
#
# Release order across the orin-axi repositories is human-tracked (Wisp D-024):
# michi → wisp-contracts → monokl → wisp. Within this repository Callisto orders
# the crates by their dependency graph.

[changesets]
dir = ".changeset"

[cascade]
mode = "out-of-range"
bump-severity = "patch"
peer-escalation = true

# [[package-set]] globs match by package NAME, not directory path, so explicit
# per-crate [[package]] blocks match by path. The workspace still carries
# `publish = false`; these entries describe the intended publication surface and
# take effect when that flag is lifted.

# Permissive interchange layer (MIT). Published first; everything else depends on it.
[[package]]
match = "crates/wisp-contracts"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "crates/wisp-model"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

# FSL-1.1-MIT layer.
[[package]]
match = "crates/wisp-schema"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "crates/wisp-artifacts"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

[[package]]
match = "crates/wisp-cli"
publish-to = ["crates-io"]
release-trigger = "changeset"

# wisp-fixtures is test-only and never published.

dir = ".changeset"

[[fixed-group]]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust toolchain & cache (matches rust-toolchain.toml's pin)
        uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@v1.1
        with:
          components: clippy,rustfmt

      # just and cargo-deny have no working proto plugin; install them directly.
      # Same arrangement as Lumen and Michi.
      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@v2

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Run CI pipeline
        run: just ci

# affected crates' own source, not their downstream dependents -- clippy
# warnings are about a crate's own code, not its callers.
lint-affected:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    projects=$(moon query projects --affected 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.projects[].id // empty')
    if [ -z "$projects" ]; then
        echo "No affected crates; skipping lint."
        exit 0
    fi
    # Root-level changes (manifests, toolchain, lint config) affect every crate.
    if grep -qx michi-workspace <<< "$projects"; then
        echo "Workspace root affected; linting every crate."
        cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
        exit 0
    fi
    args=()
    while IFS= read -r p; do
        args+=(-p "$p")
    done <<< "$projects"
    echo "Linting affected crates: ${args[*]}"
    cargo clippy "${args[@]}" --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

clippy:
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings

fmt:
    moon run :format

format: fmt

fmt-check:
    moon run :format-check

fmt-md:
    CI=true pnpm exec oxfmt --ignore-path=.oxfmtignore --write "**/*.md"

fmt-md-check:
    CI=true pnpm exec oxfmt --ignore-path=.oxfmtignore --check "**/*.md"

typos:
    typos

deny:
    cargo deny check

audit:
    moon run :audit

# ── Documentation Checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
doc: doc-check

doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features
    # Default features alone: intra-doc links to feature-gated items only break here.
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p michi-core --no-deps

# API SemVer check of the published crates against their latest crates.io release (the default baseline). CI runs the
# same check.
check-api:
    bash scripts/check-semver.sh

# Unused-dependency check.
machete:
    cargo machete

# ── Examples & Benchmarks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
examples:
    moon run :examples

example name:
    cargo run -p michi-core --example {{name}}

snapshots:
    cargo insta review

snapshots-accept:
    cargo insta test --accept

bench:
    cargo bench --workspace

bench-baseline:
    cargo bench --workspace -- --save-baseline main

# Mutation testing sweep, workspace-wide. Complements the per-task mutation
# checks the implementation workflow already runs during development
# (surviving mutants get precision tests before a task's exit gate) with a
# standing, repeatable local/CI command over the whole tree.
mutants:
    cargo mutants --workspace

# ── Fuzzing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Run one cargo-fuzz target from fuzz/ for `seconds` (default 60). Needs `rustup toolchain install nightly` and
# `cargo install cargo-fuzz --locked`. Targets: toon_render truncate resilience mcp_wire graph plan. Not part of
# `check` or `ci`: fuzz/ is outside the workspace and a bounded run proves nothing by passing.
fuzz target seconds="60":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    test -f "fuzz/fuzz_targets/{{target}}.rs" || { echo "no such target: {{target}}"; ls fuzz/fuzz_targets; exit 1; }
    args=("fuzz/corpus/{{target}}")
    mkdir -p "fuzz/corpus/{{target}}"
    if [ -d "fuzz/seeds/{{target}}" ]; then args+=("fuzz/seeds/{{target}}"); fi
    opts=(-max_total_time={{seconds}})
    if [ -f "fuzz/dictionaries/{{target}}.dict" ]; then opts+=("-dict=fuzz/dictionaries/{{target}}.dict"); fi
    # cargo-fuzz defaults --target to its own build's triple. CI installs a musl build of it, and nightly rejects the
    # address sanitizer on statically linked musl, so build for the nightly toolchain's host instead.
    host=$(rustc +nightly -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')
    cargo +nightly fuzz run --target "$host" "{{target}}" "${args[@]}" -- "${opts[@]}"

# ── Continuous Development ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
watch:
    cargo watch -x "check --workspace --all-features"

# ── Coverage & Cleanup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coverage:
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --lcov --output-path lcov.info

clean:
    moon clean 2>/dev/null || true
    cargo clean
    rm -f lcov.info

# ── Git Hooks & Pre-push ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pre-commit: fmt-check

pre-push: fmt-check lint-affected

hooks:
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-commit' > .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
    @echo '#!/bin/sh\njust pre-push' > .git/hooks/pre-push
    @chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-push
    @echo "Git pre-commit and pre-push hooks installed successfully."

# ── CI Verification Pipeline ───────────────────────────────────────────────
check-all: ci

ci: fmt-check lint test test-rust-release audit doc-check

    cargo install cargo-nextest cargo-llvm-cov cargo-machete cargo-mutants cargo-deny typos-cli zizmor --locked

    proto install
    moon sync vcs-hooks

# Build the workspace. One `cargo --workspace` invocation, not `moon run :build`: per-crate cargo processes all
# contend for the same target/ lock and serialize.
build:

build-release:
    cargo build --workspace --release --locked

# Run tests with nextest, plus doctests, which nextest does not run. The default-features pass catches code that only
# builds because --all-features turned something on.
test:

    cargo nextest run --workspace --locked

# Line coverage; with a threshold, fails below it
coverage threshold="":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --locked --lcov --output-path lcov.info
    cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only
    if [[ -n "{{ threshold }}" ]]; then
      cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines "{{ threshold }}"
    fi

# Coverage report, opened in the browser
coverage-html:
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --locked --html --open

# Format check and clippy, with and without default features
lint:
    cargo fmt --all --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --no-default-features --locked -- -D warnings

# Clippy on the crates moon reports as affected, in one cargo invocation

    #!/usr/bin/env bash

fmt:
    cargo fmt --all

doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --all-features --locked
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --locked

# Licenses, advisories, bans and sources
deny:
    cargo deny check

# Unused dependencies
machete:
    cargo machete

typos:
    typos

# Callisto config, package discovery and pending changesets; the same gate as CI's Changesets job
changesets:
    callisto status --check
    callisto release --dry-run --format text

# Run by the moon-managed pre-push hook
pre-push: pre-commit lint-affected

# Everything the CI jobs run
ci: lint test doc-check deny machete typos zizmor changesets (coverage "90")

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

# Each job runs `just` recipes, so `just ci` locally does what CI does.
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: clippy,rustfmt
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@8cca0918f8471c33515202b73f56ab27f2bed283 # v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-machete,typos
      - run: just lint doc-check machete typos

  test:
    name: Test / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@8cca0918f8471c33515202b73f56ab27f2bed283 # v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest
      - run: just test

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@8cca0918f8471c33515202b73f56ab27f2bed283 # v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - run: just coverage 90
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: lcov.info
          retention-days: 14

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@8cca0918f8471c33515202b73f56ab27f2bed283 # v2.87.29
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-deny,zizmor@1.29.0
      - run: just deny zizmor

  changesets:
    name: Changesets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@3feff402ea4798c4708ec6fa09e402b956596598 # callisto@0.14.0

  # The one check to require in branch protection.
  ci:
    name: CI
    needs: [lint, test, msrv, coverage, audit, changesets]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

file.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  INSTA_UPDATE: "no"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  # Cheap, standalone check that .prototools is fully proto-installable.
  # This is the ONLY thing in this file that exercises the same
  # moonrepo/setup-toolchain -> proto install path callisto-release.yml's
  # Callisto actions use internally -- without this job, .prototools could
  # break silently and only surface at actual release time (which is what
  # happened: multiple tools here had no working proto plugin, and CI
  # stayed green through all of it since nothing here ever touched proto).
  prototools:
    name: .prototools is installable
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt,clippy
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: typos
        uses: crate-ci/typos@7f9d0819ca1c008ade73f4b41fa9d258d48f605b # v1.51.1

  docs:
    name: Docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - run: cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features
      # Default features on their own: intra-doc links to feature-gated items only break here.
      - run: cargo doc -p michi-core --no-deps

  markdown:
    name: Markdown format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: CI=true pnpm exec oxfmt --ignore-path=.oxfmtignore --check "**/*.md"

  semver:
    name: SemVer (against crates.io)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-semver-checks
      # The baseline is the latest version of each crate published on crates.io. The release type comes from the
      # pending changesets, translated to cargo-semver-checks' terms: it names release types literally, so a breaking
      # change needs `major` even before 1.0, where Callisto's minor bump (0.3 -> 0.4) is the breaking bump.
      - run: python3 scripts/test_pending_release_type.py
      - name: Check API compatibility against the pending release type
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Front matter of the fixed group's changesets, or the version bump when none are pending, as on Callisto's
          # version PR.
          bash scripts/check-semver.sh

  # Spec first: a PR that changes public Rust API must also touch the docs (docs/spec, docs/adr, a README or
  # ARCHITECTURE.md), or say why not with a `No spec change needed: <reason>` line in the PR body. The body is read
  # live, so after editing it, re-run this job.
  api-docs:
    name: Spec updated with API changes
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: python3 scripts/test_check_api_docs.py
      - run: python3 scripts/test_released_version.py
      - name: Check the spec moves with the API
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PR_BODY="$(gh pr view "$PR_URL" --json body --jq .body)"
          export PR_BODY
          python3 scripts/check-api-docs.py "origin/$BASE_REF" HEAD

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read rust-version from Cargo.toml
        id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(grep -m1 '^rust-version' Cargo.toml | sed -E 's/rust-version *= *"(.*)"/\1/')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
          cache-key: msrv
      # `+version` because rust-toolchain.toml (stable) would otherwise win over the default toolchain.
      - run: cargo "+$MSRV" check --workspace --all-features --locked
        env:
          MSRV: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}

  fuzz-build:
    name: Fuzz targets build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          cache-key: fuzz-build
      # fuzz/ is outside the workspace, so nothing else compiles it: an API change would break its targets unnoticed.
      # Without --locked: Callisto bumps the michi versions, which the fuzz crate's own lockfile does not follow.
      - run: cargo check --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --bins

  workflow-security:
    name: Workflow security (zizmor)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # Static audit of the workflows: template injection, credential persistence, excessive permissions. The version
      # matches `just zizmor`.
      - run: pipx run zizmor==1.29.0 --offline .github

  graph-license:
    name: michi-graph stays permissive
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - run: python3 scripts/test_check_permissive_deps.py
      # michi-graph is MIT inside an FSL workspace: no non-permissive crate may enter what it ships.
      - run: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --all-features | python3 scripts/check-permissive-deps.py michi-graph

  graph-no-std:
    name: michi-graph builds without std
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          targets: thumbv7em-none-eabihf
          cache-key: graph-no-std
      # A bare-metal target with no std: proves the crate is no_std + alloc. It needs pointer-sized atomics (Arc and
      # the builder id), which thumbv7em has; targets without compare-and-swap (thumbv6m) are not supported.
      - run: cargo build -p michi-graph --target thumbv7em-none-eabihf

  version-sync:
    name: Version sync
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0.6.4
        with:
          auto-install: true
      - name: Assert every published package has the same version
        run: |
          crate_version() { grep -m1 '^version' "$1" | sed -E 's/version *= *"(.*)"/\1/'; }
          CORE=$(crate_version crates/michi-core/Cargo.toml)
          GRAPH=$(crate_version crates/michi-graph/Cargo.toml)
          PIPELINE=$(crate_version crates/michi-pipeline/Cargo.toml)
          NPM=$(node -p "require('./packages/michi-node/package.json').version")
          echo "michi-core: $CORE  michi-graph: $GRAPH  michi-pipeline: $PIPELINE  @orin-dx/michi: $NPM"
          if [ "$CORE" != "$GRAPH" ] || [ "$CORE" != "$PIPELINE" ] || [ "$CORE" != "$NPM" ]; then
            echo "::error::Version mismatch: michi-core=$CORE michi-graph=$GRAPH michi-pipeline=$PIPELINE @orin-dx/michi=$NPM"
            exit 1
          fi

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,just
      - run: cargo nextest run --workspace
      - run: cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features
      # Each published crate on its own, with only its default features. A workspace-wide run unifies features (the
      # napi shim turns on michi-core's serde), which hid a default-feature failure.
      - run: just test-crates-default
      # nextest does not run doctests (the crate docs and the michi-pipeline and michi-graph README examples).
      # Not `napi`: doctest binaries can't link the Node symbols it references.
      - run: cargo test --doc -p michi-core --features serde,schemars,miette
      - run: cargo test --doc -p michi-pipeline --all-features
      - run: cargo test --doc -p michi-graph

  deny:
    name: Deny
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@3c6349835b2b7b196a839186cb8b78e02f7b5f25 # v2.1.1

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov,cargo-nextest
      - run: cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --lcov --output-path lcov.info
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          files: lcov.info
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  bench-build:
    name: Bench (build only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - run: cargo bench --no-run --workspace

  lint-js:
    name: Lint (JS/TS)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/michi-node
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: packages/michi-node
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm lint

  napi:
    name: NAPI (${{ matrix.target }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      # Every target in packages/michi-node/package.json's napi.targets. `cross`
      # links with cargo-zigbuild, as the release build does for these targets.
      # `test` runs the Node tests only where the runner executes the binary
      # natively: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu builds on GitHub's arm64 runner for
      # that (still linked with cargo-zigbuild, so it tests the release's glibc
      # linkage), and musl or x86_64 macOS binaries can't load in the runner's Node.
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
            test: true
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            test: true
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            cross: true
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            cross: true
            test: true
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            cross: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
          cache-key: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: packages/michi-node
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: packages/michi-node
      - name: Install ziglang (cross-compile targets only)
        if: matrix.cross
        run: pip install ziglang
      - name: Cache cargo-zigbuild binary (cross-compile targets only)
        if: matrix.cross
        id: zigbuild-cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/bin/cargo-zigbuild
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-cargo-zigbuild-${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Install cargo-zigbuild (cross-compile targets only)
        if: matrix.cross && steps.zigbuild-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: cargo install cargo-zigbuild --locked
      - run: pnpm build --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.cross && '--cross-compile' || '' }}
        working-directory: packages/michi-node
      - run: node --test __test__/index.test.mjs __test__/interop.test.mjs __test__/mcp-conformance.test.mjs
        working-directory: packages/michi-node
        if: matrix.test

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain (pinned via rust-toolchain.toml)
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache cargo registry and build artifacts
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Setup moon toolchain (moon, just, cargo-deny via .prototools)
        uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@v0

      - name: Run CI pipeline
        run: just ci

1	name: Release
2	
3	# Callisto's build-matrix release flow for napi platform packages
4	# (docs/releasing.md in orin-dx/callisto): a push to main either refreshes the
5	# Callisto version PR or, for a merged version PR, runs plan -> build ->
6	# execute. Keep this filename: Callisto's recovery docs and coordinator
7	# identity name `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`.
8	
9	on:
10	  push:
11	    branches: [main]
12	  workflow_dispatch:
13	    inputs:
14	      release_source_sha:
15	        description: 'Merged Callisto version-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
16	        required: false
17	        type: string
18	
19	permissions: {}
20	
21	# One group per commit: GitHub replaces a pending run in a shared group, which
22	# could silently drop a release merge queued behind an unrelated push.
23	concurrency:
24	  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
25	  cancel-in-progress: false
26	
27	defaults:
28	  run:
29	    shell: bash
30	
31	jobs:
32	  release-candidate:
33	    name: Identify a merged Callisto version PR
34	    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
35	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
36	    permissions:
37	      contents: read
38	      pull-requests: read
39	    outputs:
40	      is_release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.is_release }}
41	      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
42	      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
43	    steps:
44	      # Scheduling only: `callisto release plan` verifies the actual
45	      # parent-to-merge delta. A release must also be a GitHub-verified merge
46	      # of the managed PR, never a direct push.
47	      - name: Check release-source provenance
48	        id: provenance
49	        env:
50	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
51	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
52	          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
53	        run: |
54	          set -euo pipefail
55	          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
56	          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
57	            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
58	            exit 1
59	          fi
60	          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
61	          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
62	            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
63	            exit 1
64	          fi
65	          # gh rejects --slurp together with --jq, so slurp the pages and filter with jq.
66	          prs=$(gh api --paginate --slurp "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" |
67	            jq --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and
68	              .head.repo.full_name == $repo and
69	              (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or
70	               (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
71	          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" \
72	            --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
73	          managed=false
74	          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then managed=true; fi
75	          {
76	            echo "managed=$managed"
77	            echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
78	            # The current run coordinates; a recovery never reruns historic workflow code.
79	            echo "orchestration_sha=$TRIGGERING_SHA"
80	          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
81	
82	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
83	        if: steps.provenance.outputs.managed == 'true'
84	        with:
85	          ref: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
86	          fetch-depth: 2
87	          persist-credentials: false
88	
89	      # `release plan --from-release-commit` requires the commit to write its
90	      # release decision. A managed PR without one (e.g. a workflow fix merged
91	      # from a callisto/ branch) refreshes the version PR instead.
92	      - name: Check for a release decision
93	        id: decision
94	        env:
95	          MANAGED: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.managed }}
96	        run: |
97	          set -euo pipefail
98	          is_release=false
99	          if [[ "$MANAGED" == true ]] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
100	            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
101	            is_release=true
102	          fi
103	          echo "is_release=$is_release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
104	
105	  version-pr:
106	    name: Create or update the Callisto version PR
107	    needs: release-candidate
108	    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release != 'true'
109	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
110	    concurrency:
111	      group: callisto-version-pr
112	      cancel-in-progress: false
113	    permissions:
114	      contents: write
115	      pull-requests: write
116	    steps:
117	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
118	        with:
119	          fetch-depth: 0
120	          persist-credentials: false
121	
122	      # The default version command (`callisto version`) refreshes lockfiles
123	      # and the action appends --emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json.
124	      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
125	        with:
126	          mode: version-pr
127	          version: callisto@0.17.0
128	          branch: main
129	          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
130	        env:
131	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
132	
133	  plan:
134	    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
135	    needs: release-candidate
136	    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release == 'true'
137	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
138	    permissions:
139	      contents: read
140	    outputs:
141	      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
142	      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
143	      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
144	    steps:
145	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
146	        with:
147	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
148	          fetch-depth: 0
149	          persist-credentials: false
150	
151	      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
152	        with:
153	          version: callisto@0.17.0
154	
155	      - name: Plan the release
156	        env:
157	          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
158	          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
159	        run: |
160	          set -euo pipefail
161	          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
162	          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
163	            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
164	            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
165	          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
166	
167	      - name: Build the matrix from the intent's napi targets
168	        id: matrix
169	        run: |
170	          set -euo pipefail
171	          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
172	          # This workflow builds napi addons only. Artifact slots or PyPI
173	          # publishes need the generated workflow's artifact-manifest path.
174	          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and
175	            ([.operations[].id.package | select(startswith("pypi/"))] == [])' "$intent" > /dev/null; then
176	            echo "::error::the release intent declares artifact slots or PyPI publishes, which this workflow does not build"
177	            exit 1
178	          fi
179	          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build.
180	          {
181	            while IFS= read -r package; do
182	              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
183	            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
184	          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
185	          # Callisto 0.11 schedules x86_64-apple-darwin on macos-13, a retired
186	          # runner image: build it on the arm64 macos-latest instead, where
187	          # rustup's x86_64-apple-darwin target links with Apple's universal SDK.
188	          # Every other target keeps Callisto's hostRunner/useCross (aarch64
189	          # Linux cross-compiles with cargo-zigbuild on ubuntu-latest).
190	          matrix=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind == "napi") | .targets[]] | unique_by(.artifactName) |
191	            map(if .triple == "x86_64-apple-darwin" then .hostRunner = "macos-latest" | .useCross = false else . end)' \
192	            "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json")
193	          # Execute places one package's JS binding; a second addon needs per-package placement. A release with no
194	          # addon skips the build and placement entirely (the fixed group always includes the npm package today).
195	          napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$matrix")
196	          case $(jq length <<< "$napi_dirs") in
197	            0) has_napi=false napi_dir="" ;;
198	            1) has_napi=true napi_dir=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$napi_dirs") ;;
199	            *)
200	              echo "::error::expected at most one napi package directory, got $napi_dirs"
201	              exit 1
202	              ;;
203	          esac
204	          {
205	            echo "matrix=$matrix"
206	            echo "napi_dir=$napi_dir"
207	            echo "has_napi=$has_napi"
208	          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
209	
210	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
211	        with:
212	          name: release-intent
213	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
214	          if-no-files-found: error
215	          retention-days: 7
216	
217	  build:
218	    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
219	    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
220	    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
221	    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
222	    strategy:
223	      fail-fast: false
224	      matrix:
225	        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
226	    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
227	    permissions:
228	      contents: read
229	    env:
230	      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
231	      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
232	    defaults:
233	      run:
234	        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
235	    steps:
236	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
237	        with:
238	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
239	          persist-credentials: false
240	
241	      - name: Install the Rust target
242	        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"
243	
244	      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
245	        with:
246	          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
247	          cache: 'false'
248	
249	      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
250	
251	      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild.
252	      - name: Install zig
253	        if: matrix.useCross
254	        run: pip install ziglang
255	
256	      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
257	        if: matrix.useCross
258	        with:
259	          tool: cargo-zigbuild
260	
261	      # --output-dir keeps the checkout clean; napi writes the .node file and
262	      # the generated index.js/index.d.ts there.
263	      - name: Build the napi addon
264	        run: |
265	          set -euo pipefail
266	          args=(--release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
267	          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--cross-compile); fi
268	          pnpm build "${args[@]}"
269	
270	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
271	        with:
272	          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
273	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
274	          if-no-files-found: error
275	          retention-days: 7
276	
277	      # index.js and index.d.ts are gitignored build outputs the npm package ships.
278	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
279	        with:
280	          name: binding-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
281	          path: |
282	            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.js
283	            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.d.ts
284	          if-no-files-found: error
285	          retention-days: 7
286	
287	  execute:
288	    name: Execute the planned release
289	    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build]
290	    # !cancelled() rather than always(): cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
291	    if: >-
292	      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
293	      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false'))
294	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
295	    concurrency:
296	      group: callisto-release-execute
297	      cancel-in-progress: false
298	    permissions:
299	      contents: write
300	      id-token: write
301	    outputs:
302	      smoke_version: ${{ steps.published.outputs.version }}
303	    steps:
304	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
305	        with:
306	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
307	          fetch-depth: 0
308	          # Callisto pushes the release tags from this checkout.
309	          persist-credentials: true # zizmor: ignore[artipacked]
310	
311	      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
312	        with:
313	          version: callisto@0.17.0
314	
315	      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
316	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
317	        with:
318	          working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
319	          cache: 'false'
320	
321	      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
322	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
323	        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
324	
325	      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
326	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
327	        with:
328	          name: release-intent
329	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
330	
331	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
332	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
333	        with:
334	          pattern: napi-*
335	          merge-multiple: true
336	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts
337	
338	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
339	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
340	        with:
341	          pattern: binding-*
342	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-bindings
343	
344	      - name: Verify the handoff
345	        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
346	
347	      # Everything placed here is gitignored, so the checkout stays clean:
348	      # the .node files go into the committed npm/<platform> package dirs.
349	      - name: Place the napi artifacts
350	        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
351	        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
352	        run: |
353	          set -euo pipefail
354	          bindings=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*)
355	          for binding in "${bindings[@]}"; do
356	            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "$binding/index.js"
357	            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" "$binding/index.d.ts"
358	          done
359	          cp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" .
360	          # napi 3.7 joins --output-dir onto the package directory, so pass it relative.
361	          pnpm exec napi artifacts --output-dir "$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts")"
362	          for manifest in npm/*/package.json; do
363	            binary="$(dirname "$manifest")/$(jq -r .main "$manifest")"
364	            if [[ ! -f "$binary" ]]; then
365	              echo "::error::missing napi artifact $binary"
366	              exit 1
367	            fi
368	          done
369	          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
370	            git status --porcelain
371	            echo "::error::artifact placement dirtied the release checkout"
372	            exit 1
373	          fi
374	
375	      - name: Execute the release
376	        env:
377	          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
378	          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
379	          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
380	          # pnpm 11 publishes the main package natively and ignores NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE (npm, which publishes the six
381	          # platform packages, honours it). Without this, @orin-dx/michi shipped with no attestation through 0.7.1.
382	          PNPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
383	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
384	          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
385	        run: |
386	          set -euo pipefail
387	          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
388	          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
389	          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
390	          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
391	          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
392	          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
393	          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
394	          callisto release execute --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
395	            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" \
396	            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA"
397	
398	      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
399	      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
400	      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
401	      # skips the post-release smoke test.
402	      - name: Find the version this run released
403	        id: published
404	        run: |
405	          set -euo pipefail
406	          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
407	          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
408	
409	      - name: Summarize the receipt
410	        if: always()
411	        run: |
412	          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
413	          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
414	            {
415	              echo '### Release receipt'
416	              echo '```json'
417	              cat "$receipt"
418	              echo '```'
419	            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
420	          fi
421	
422	      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
423	        if: always()
424	        with:
425	          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
426	          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
427	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
428	          if-no-files-found: ignore
429	          retention-days: 30
430	
431	  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
432	  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
433	  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
434	  smoke-published:
435	    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
436	    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
437	    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
438	    strategy:
439	      fail-fast: false
440	      matrix:
441	        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
442	    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
443	    timeout-minutes: 30
444	    permissions:
445	      contents: read
446	    env:
447	      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
448	      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
449	      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
450	    steps:
451	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
452	        with:
453	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
454	          persist-credentials: false
455	
456	      - name: Install the published packages and use them
457	        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"
458

file.content:
name: Release

# Callisto's build-matrix release flow for napi platform packages
# (docs/releasing.md in orin-dx/callisto): a push to main either refreshes the
# Callisto version PR or, for a merged version PR, runs plan -> build ->
# execute. Keep this filename: Callisto's recovery docs and coordinator
# identity name `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml`.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged Callisto version-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One group per commit: GitHub replaces a pending run in a shared group, which
# could silently drop a release merge queued behind an unrelated push.
concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto version PR
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release: ${{ steps.decision.outputs.is_release }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      # Scheduling only: `callisto release plan` verifies the actual
      # parent-to-merge delta. A release must also be a GitHub-verified merge
      # of the managed PR, never a direct push.
      - name: Check release-source provenance
        id: provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="${RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh rejects --slurp together with --jq, so slurp the pages and filter with jq.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate --slurp "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" |
            jq --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and
              .head.repo.full_name == $repo and
              (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or
               (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" \
            --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          managed=false
          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then managed=true; fi
          {
            echo "managed=$managed"
            echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
            # The current run coordinates; a recovery never reruns historic workflow code.
            echo "orchestration_sha=$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: steps.provenance.outputs.managed == 'true'
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false

      # `release plan --from-release-commit` requires the commit to write its
      # release decision. A managed PR without one (e.g. a workflow fix merged
      # from a callisto/ branch) refreshes the version PR instead.
      - name: Check for a release decision
        id: decision
        env:
          MANAGED: ${{ steps.provenance.outputs.managed }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          is_release=false
          if [[ "$MANAGED" == true ]] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^ > /dev/null &&
            git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only --diff-filter=AM -r HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qxF .callisto/release-decision.json; then
            is_release=true
          fi
          echo "is_release=$is_release" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      # The default version command (`callisto version`) refreshes lockfiles
      # and the action appends --emit-decision .callisto/release-decision.json.
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-action@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          mode: version-pr
          version: callisto@0.17.0
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Plan the release from the merged version PR
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      napi_dir: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.napi_dir }}
      has_napi: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.has_napi }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0

      - name: Plan the release
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent"
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)

      - name: Build the matrix from the intent's napi targets
        id: matrix
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          # This workflow builds napi addons only. Artifact slots or PyPI
          # publishes need the generated workflow's artifact-manifest path.
          if ! jq -e '(.artifactSlots // []) == [] and
            ([.operations[].id.package | select(startswith("pypi/"))] == [])' "$intent" > /dev/null; then
            echo "::error::the release intent declares artifact slots or PyPI publishes, which this workflow does not build"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Only packages in the release intent: an unrelated addon adds no build.
          {
            while IFS= read -r package; do
              callisto --format json matrix --package "$package"
            done < <(jq -r '[.operations[].id.package] | unique[]' "$intent")
          } | jq -s '{platformTargets: (map(.platformTargets) | add // {})}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json"
          # Callisto 0.11 schedules x86_64-apple-darwin on macos-13, a retired
          # runner image: build it on the arm64 macos-latest instead, where
          # rustup's x86_64-apple-darwin target links with Apple's universal SDK.
          # Every other target keeps Callisto's hostRunner/useCross (aarch64
          # Linux cross-compiles with cargo-zigbuild on ubuntu-latest).
          matrix=$(jq -c '[.platformTargets[] | select(.kind == "napi") | .targets[]] | unique_by(.artifactName) |
            map(if .triple == "x86_64-apple-darwin" then .hostRunner = "macos-latest" | .useCross = false else . end)' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/matrix.json")
          # Execute places one package's JS binding; a second addon needs per-package placement. A release with no
          # addon skips the build and placement entirely (the fixed group always includes the npm package today).
          napi_dirs=$(jq -c '[.[].packageDir] | unique' <<< "$matrix")
          case $(jq length <<< "$napi_dirs") in
            0) has_napi=false napi_dir="" ;;
            1) has_napi=true napi_dir=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$napi_dirs") ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::expected at most one napi package directory, got $napi_dirs"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          {
            echo "matrix=$matrix"
            echo "napi_dir=$napi_dir"
            echo "has_napi=$has_napi"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.triple }}
    needs: [release-candidate, plan]
    # An empty matrix is an error in GitHub Actions, so a release without an addon skips the job instead.
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.hostRunner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TRIPLE: ${{ matrix.triple }}
      USE_CROSS: ${{ matrix.useCross }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild.
      - name: Install zig
        if: matrix.useCross
        run: pip install ziglang

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        if: matrix.useCross
        with:
          tool: cargo-zigbuild

      # --output-dir keeps the checkout clean; napi writes the .node file and
      # the generated index.js/index.d.ts there.
      - name: Build the napi addon
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--release --target "$TRIPLE" --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-out")
          if [[ "$USE_CROSS" == true ]]; then args+=(--cross-compile); fi
          pnpm build "${args[@]}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: napi-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      # index.js and index.d.ts are gitignored build outputs the npm package ships.
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: binding-${{ matrix.artifactName }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.js
            ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-out/index.d.ts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute the planned release
    needs: [release-candidate, plan, build]
    # !cancelled() rather than always(): cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.build.result == 'success' || (needs.build.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'false'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: callisto-release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      smoke_version: ${{ steps.published.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Callisto pushes the release tags from this checkout.
          persist-credentials: true # zizmor: ignore[artipacked]

      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@ff116694c00f08ce7edc3f1b00ed4fa1d6ffd084 # callisto@0.17.0
        with:
          version: callisto@0.17.0

      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}

      # Downloads land under $RUNNER_TEMP: `release execute` requires a clean worktree.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: napi-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-artifacts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: binding-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/napi-bindings

      - name: Verify the handoff
        run: (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)

      # Everything placed here is gitignored, so the checkout stays clean:
      # the .node files go into the committed npm/<platform> package dirs.
      - name: Place the napi artifacts
        if: needs.plan.outputs.has_napi == 'true'
        working-directory: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.napi_dir }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bindings=("$RUNNER_TEMP"/napi-bindings/*)
          for binding in "${bindings[@]}"; do
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "$binding/index.js"
            cmp "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" "$binding/index.d.ts"
          done
          cp "${bindings[0]}/index.js" "${bindings[0]}/index.d.ts" .
          # napi 3.7 joins --output-dir onto the package directory, so pass it relative.
          pnpm exec napi artifacts --output-dir "$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/napi-artifacts")"
          for manifest in npm/*/package.json; do
            binary="$(dirname "$manifest")/$(jq -r .main "$manifest")"
            if [[ ! -f "$binary" ]]; then
              echo "::error::missing napi artifact $binary"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::artifact placement dirtied the release checkout"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Execute the release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          # pnpm 11 publishes the main package natively and ignores NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE (npm, which publishes the six
          # platform packages, honours it). Without this, @orin-dx/michi shipped with no attestation through 0.7.1.
          PNPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: 'true'
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Callisto hands this config only to its npm publishers; the token
          # stays an ${NPM_TOKEN} reference, never written to disk.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          chmod 600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/callisto-npmrc"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt"
          callisto release execute --intent "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-intent/release-intent.json" \
            --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA"

      # Callisto writes the receipt only after every selected operation succeeded. A registry publish that landed in
      # this run (`published`) or that a re-run adopted from a failed earlier attempt (`alreadySatisfied`) names the
      # released version here. A receipt without registry publishes, or no receipt, leaves the output empty and
      # skips the post-release smoke test.
      - name: Find the version this run released
        id: published
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version=$(scripts/released-version.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json")
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Summarize the receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-receipt/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          # Per attempt: a re-run keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing it.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-receipt
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

  # Installs the versions just published from the public registries into clean projects on each platform we ship
  # prebuilt binaries for, and uses them (scripts/smoke-published.sh). Needs no secrets and no write access. It
  # cannot undo a release: a failure here is the alarm that the published packages are broken.
  smoke-published:
    name: Smoke-test the published release (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [release-candidate, execute]
    if: needs.execute.result == 'success' && needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version != ''
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RELEASED_VERSION: ${{ needs.execute.outputs.smoke_version }}
      # Every npm package of this release must carry provenance; a missing one fails the job.
      SMOKE_REQUIRE_ATTESTATIONS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the published packages and use them
        run: scripts/smoke-published.sh "$RELEASED_VERSION"

resolver = "3"
members = ["crates/*"]

edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
repository = "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto"
homepage = "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto"
keywords = ["monorepo", "changesets", "release-management", "versioning", "moon"]
categories = ["development-tools", "command-line-utilities"]

# Pinned once here, not per-crate: bump_version's byte-exactness claim

semver = { version = "1", features = ["serde"] }
pep440_rs = "0.7"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1", features = ["preserve_order"] }
thiserror = "2"
michi-graph = "0.9"
indexmap = { version = "2", features = ["serde"] }

toml_edit = "0.25"
ignore = "0.4"

globset = "0.4"
camino = { version = "1", features = ["serde1"] }
dunce = "1"
path-slash = "0.2"

tracing = "0.1"

schemars = "1"

yaml-rust2 = { version = "0.13", default-features = false }
sha2 = "0.11"
base64 = "0.23"
